rotation.marker: Sun Nov 15 — 90-day confirmation + first Quarterly Lead Review

openingMessage: What can I do about it now? That's the only question that matters when something isn't right. The moment you stop blaming, you gain control. That's where leadership begins.
openingWhy: Valve's weeping, the spotter didn't show, the wrong kill water got delivered — you can burn an hour on whose fault it is, or handle it and sort the story after. The leak doesn't pause for the argument. The hand asking 'what now' is running the job while everyone else runs the trial.
leadershipThought: Inspect your harness before you put it on. Not because you were told to — because you know what wear looks like at altitude and you own what happens next.
